setup.shell:
cat > /tmp/opencode/mst_ui.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
DRIVE = ["python3", "qa/drive.py", "--port", os.environ.get("PORT") or os.environ.get("MST_QA_PORT", "8879"),
         "--display", os.environ.get("DISPLAY", ":79")]


def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run(DRIVE + [str(x) for x in a], cwd=os.environ.get("ROOT", "."),
                          capture_output=True, text=True)


def dump():
    p = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".json")
    r = run("ui", "--filter", "", "--save", p)
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit("ui failed: " + r.stderr[-300:])
    d = json.load(open(p)); os.unlink(p)
    return [c for c in d["controls"] if c.get("rect") and c["rect"][2] > 0 and c["rect"][3] > 0 and c.get("visible")]


def find(name, classes=None):
    cs = dump()
    if classes:
        cs = [c for c in cs if c.get("class") in classes]
    hits = ([c for c in cs if c.get("name") == name] or [c for c in cs if c.get("text") == name]
            or [c for c in cs if c.get("tooltip") == name])
    if not hits:
        sys.exit("control not found: " + name)
    return hits[0]


def center(c):
    x, y, w, h = c["rect"]
    return int(x + w / 2), int(y + h / 2)


def path(p):
    return p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(os.environ.get("OUT", "."), p)


cmd = sys.argv[1]
if cmd == "crop":
    from PIL import Image
    out, name = path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
    pads = [int(v) for v in sys.argv[4:8]]
    c = find(name); x, y, w, h = c["rect"]
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    img = Image.open(tmp)
    rect = (max(0, x - pads[0]), max(0, y - pads[2]), min(img.width, x + w + pads[1]), min(img.height, y + h + pads[3]))
    img.crop(rect).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out, rect)
elif cmd == "croppopup":
    from PIL import Image
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); pad = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 12
    pp = run("popups"); pop = json.loads(pp.stdout)["popups"][0]
    x, y = pop["pos"]; w, h = pop["size"]
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    img = Image.open(tmp)
    rect = (max(0, x - pad), max(0, y - pad), min(img.width, x + w + pad), min(img.height, y + h + pad))
    img.crop(rect).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out, rect)
elif cmd == "cropwin":
    from PIL import Image
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); x, y, w, h = [int(v) for v in sys.argv[3:7]]
    tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    Image.open(tmp).crop((x, y, x + w, y + h)).save(out); os.unlink(tmp); print(out)
elif cmd == "full":
    out = path(sys.argv[2]); tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".png"); run("capture", tmp)
    os.replace(tmp, out); print(out)
else:
    name = sys.argv[2]
    cls = {"option": ("OptionButton",), "slider": ("HSlider",), "spin": ("EditorSpinSlider",),
           "check": ("CheckBox",)}.get(cmd)
    c = find(name, cls)
    if cmd == "click":
        print(run("click", *center(c)).stdout[-100:])
    elif cmd == "check":
        want = sys.argv[3].lower() in ("1", "on", "true", "yes")
        if bool(c.get("toggled")) != want:
            run("click", *center(c)); time.sleep(0.3)
        print(name, "->", want)
    elif cmd == "spin":
        x, y = center(c)
        run("click", x, y); time.sleep(0.4)
        run("key", "a", "--ctrl"); run("type", sys.argv[3]); run("key", "enter"); time.sleep(0.4)
        print(name, ":=", sys.argv[3])
    elif cmd == "slider":
        frac = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(sys.argv[3]))); x, y, w, h = c["rect"]
        tx = int(x + 2 + frac * (w - 4)); yy = int(y + h / 2)
        run("drag", tx - 1, yy, tx + 1, yy, "--duration", "0.2"); time.sleep(0.4)
        print(name, "->", frac)
    elif cmd == "option":
        idx = int(sys.argv[3]); run("click", *center(c)); time.sleep(0.8)
        p = run("popups")
        pops = json.loads(p.stdout).get("popups", [])
        if not pops:
            sys.exit("option: no popup opened for " + name)
        pop = pops[0]; px, py = pop["pos"]
        ih = pop["size"][1] / max(len(pop["items"]), 1)
        run("click", px + 30, int(py + ih * (idx + 0.5))); time.sleep(0.5)
        print(name, "->", idx)


PYEOF
